scientific_scope: Selected within-model numerical stability of baseline, heavy vehicles and rain; not physical calibration, general convergence, or validation of all holdout/Morris settings.
controls: Keep routes, network, horizon, seed, ballistic integration, collision/teleport settings and action clock unchanged. Set every vType sigmaStep explicitly within each stratum. No fitting or favorable-setting selection.
clock_rationale: Both 0.05 and 0.02 divide fixed action 0.1 and stochastic 0.1/1.0 exactly; two-decimal event times are sufficient. No Richardson order extrapolation is attempted on these stochastic hybrid-model outputs.
passive_changes: Omit FCD recording only; retain summary, trips, warnings, E1 and E2. A separate 0.1 s technical control must reproduce original traffic records exactly before new settings run.
outcome_units: Five paired seeds per state and stratum. Compare each successive grid; contrast scenario-to-baseline percent responses within each grid before comparing them in percentage points.
band_rationale: Use the existing diagnostic practical margins (2% throughput and 5% burden), not fitted convergence tolerances. Bands apply as percentages to raw-state changes and percentage points to scenario-response changes.
inference: Descriptive paired t-based 95% intervals. Entire interval within band: stability supported at this resolution; interval entirely outside band: material step sensitivity; otherwise inconclusive. All intervals and warnings retained; no claim of a formal equivalence trial or multiplicity-adjusted familywise inference.
stopping: Retain warning-bearing runs. Stop new dispatch only for execution, integrity, timing or population-accounting failure; keep active and partial runs. No automatic overwrite.
